title: Devil's Spawn Origin Mod
body:
A collection of custom origins for the Devil's Spawn Roleplay

Changes/additions will be made.

Current Origins:
Seer - You have increased vision and forsight.
Havoc - Combat focused abilities of one of four different types: Wind, Fire, Ice and electricty.
Stealth - You can turn invisible.
Soul - You can buff and debuff players and endities.
Plague - You can poison and debuff players and endities.
Mender - You can heal yourself and others.
Angel - You can fly and give others resistance.
